notes: Math Quiz becomes the Guild Numeracy Exams: five papers, ten topics, server-generated questions and server-held answers. Fixes the reported non-payment, which was a stale open round silently swallowing every test started in a fifteen minute window while the score row counted up to a number that was never real. Also closes two payout holes found on the way, one of them live since solitaire shipped: casino_result would settle ANY open round by id without checking which game opened it, so solitaire_start plus a crafted casino_result paid 1848 on a 250 buy-in with no cards played. SERVER + CLIENT, restart required, hard refresh required.
